facts.fact: The World Bank restructuring paper says 444 of 492 woredas use the PSNP management information system for programme tracking and 5.1 million of 7.9 million beneficiaries' data is synched in the federal MIS.
The World Bank restructuring paper says full operationalization of the PSNP MIS is underway, with completion expected by end of December 2025.
The World Bank restructuring paper says 252 woredas use electronic payments and bank accounts are opened for 1.3 million beneficiary households.
